messages:
maya: quick note — PR #4128 updates the tiny-starter quickstart (hello app) to use the new auth helper. need a quick pass on the deploy section and the token handling example before we merge.

devin: on it. i skimmed — snippets changed to use SDKv8-ish calls, but our sample repo still pins v7. will either update the repo or make the snippet backwards compatible.

lee: CI is red on the example workflow step, looks like the `DEPLOY_TARGET` var name changed. local repro: `Error: missing DEPLOY_TARGET` when running `./scripts/deploy.sh`.

ci-bot: [build/4128] failed — unit-tests (examples) failed on example-deploy.sh (exit 1). see: https://ci.redwood.run/build/4128

ashley: i'd prefer keeping quickstarts minimal. if updating repo to sdk8 is a bigger lift, we can change the snippet to show both variants and add a short note. less friction for folks copying the one-file example. :+1:

sam: i can draft a tiny diff that keeps the examples runnable for both. idea: show the modern `Redwood.client()` auth helper, then a one-line comment `// v7: use RedwoodLegacy.init()` so folks on old pin can still follow.

maya: perfect. can you also fix the inline link in the deploy step? it currently points at /docs/deploy-old which 404s. should link to /docs/deploy/serverless instead.

devin: noted. also found a small formatting nit — fenced code block language is `bash` but one of the snippets includes a JS import line, so highlight looks off. i'll split into two fenced blocks.

lee: quick patch i tested locally. changed `DEPLOY_TARGET` fallback in scripts and updated README snippet. paste from deploy.sh: ```sh
if [ -z "$DEPLOY_TARGET" ]; then
  DEPLOY_TARGET="serverless"
fi
./deploy --target "$DEPLOY_TARGET"
```

sam: sending a PR with the combined changes (snippet + link + script fallback). will link here when ready.

ci-bot: [pull/4128] checks started — examples, lint, docs-links.

sam: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4139 — includes: dual snippets (v7/v8 note), link fix to /docs/deploy/serverless, deploy.sh fallback, split fenced blocks. tests pass locally.

devin: reviewing now. small ask: please add a one-line changelog entry under docs/update-log.md — helps the release notes.

docs-bot: reminder: update the quickstart index if the example filename changed (quickstarts/index.yml).

maya: wrapping up — assigning reviewers devin + lee. if they approve today i'll merge and deploy the site refresh tomorrow AM. thanks everyone.
